cues: Tim Winton was born in nineteen sixty in Perth and grew up in Western Australia.
He published his first novel at twenty two, and has since won Australia's top fiction prize, the Miles Franklin Award, four times.
Neighbours comes from his first collection of stories, Scission, from nineteen eighty five.
